title: Neural typing character reconstruction
scientific_question: Can held-person, held-session MEG or EEG observations recover observed typed-button sequences better than a matched language-only comparator under a frozen sentence-template split?
primary_outputs: The ordered mapped V1 typed-button classes for each eligible sentence; this is observed keypress content, not corrected intended sentence text.

data_manifest.size_category: 100GB–1TB per dataset card; no measured full-storage total

recording_contract.labels: MAT logs with key/RSVP events,Time,Keycode,Pressed,stim,trial_id; derived Keystroke,Word,Sentence events
recording_contract.time_alignment: Loader aligns recording triggers to behavioral logs, including dynamic time warping of ambiguous MEG inter-event intervals; exclusions and missing matches must be recorded.
recording_contract.biological_ids: Explicit warning: different MEG subject numbers can be same person; official correction logic/spreadsheet needed before splitting. EEG test fixture20subjects is not proof of final included cohort.
recording_contract.evidence: Parent-fetched HF API metadata/tree inspected locally; pinned loader text independently inspected; license fetched directly

missing_or_unverified: This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: Pinned V1 MEG or EEG recording-derived sentence observations; exact public asset bytes remain operator-provisioned.
Training labels and a prospectively equal count of calibration sentences AND keystrokes for each target person; zero calibration allowed.
forbidden_inputs: Query keycodes, typed/intended transcripts, template text, answer-bearing filenames and logs.
Unresolved cross-modal person sharing, query-dependent preprocessing or evaluation feedback.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Evaluator requires unique opaque 32-hex query IDs and per-sentence neural-asset hashes. Authentic full ID roster is not bundled.
allowed_inputs.split: Implemented checks keep canonical people out of training versus target phases, complete source sessions and reconciled visits in one phase, and entire template families/normalized text collisions in one phase. Authentic family derivation and physical-visit map remain unverified.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Complete selected sentence inventory is required, but no authentic selected cohort or neural payload is bundled. V2 and cross-modal pooling are excluded.

biological_unit: Resolved person within one modality; do not combine EEG and MEG as disjoint people without an identity map.
case_definition: An opaque sentence query nested in a resolved biological person and physical session.

split.policy: Implemented checks keep canonical people out of training versus target phases, complete source sessions and reconciled visits in one phase, and entire template families/normalized text collisions in one phase. Authentic family derivation and physical-visit map remain unverified.
split.coverage: Complete selected sentence inventory is required, but no authentic selected cohort or neural payload is bundled. V2 and cross-modal pooling are excluded.

reference.role: Official V1 neural typing-decoder source, loader and metrics; no execution or full final-language-model result claim.

controls: Resolve MEG subject aliases before all splits.
Freeze template-family grouping and DTW exclusions before evaluation.
Retain ocular/motor contamination as an unresolved alternative; language-only comparison alone cannot isolate cerebral linguistic information.

direct_observation.representation: A fixed neural observation packet with channel/time/coordinate units and the same declared calibration support, answered without execution.
direct_observation.boundary: No evaluator targets, source-label lookup, other-case memory or model/numerical tools; a direct response is evaluated separately from programme results.
missing: Authentic complete observation presentation and no-tools response collection have not been delivered.

typed_viewer.representation: Proposed typed navigation over the permitted neural observation, with units and calibration examples.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only rendered allowed observations; no raw target arrays or unrestricted filesystem/code access. A plot alone does not establish viewer execution.
missing: Task-specific renderer/action API, complete case collection and restrictive transport are absent.

tool_assisted.representation: Case-local numerical/model-assisted investigation under a fixed observation and compute entitlement.
tool_assisted.boundary: Current query inspection may inform an allowed proposal; fit/selection remains training-only and evaluator outcomes are inaccessible. Fresh case state is required.
missing: A legacy manifest or prediction scorer does not deliver the participant investigation runtime.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted source, fitting/adaptation recipe and complete prediction output contract.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze before query access; equal declared calibration and no post-query selection from evaluator feedback. Programme success does not measure unaided interpretation.
missing: No executable participant programme is present in the assigned package.

primary.name: Neural-only person-macro sentence character error rate
primary.aggregation: Unit-cost Levenshtein edits/reference length per sentence, equal sentences within person, then equal people; retain insertions giving CER above 1.
primary.rationale: Measures recovery of observed held-out characters without rewarding a language rescorer or people with longer transcripts.

secondary: Paired neural-only minus language-only CER by person; negative favors neural observations.
Optional fixed-LM arm reported separately; constant and empty prediction diagnostics.
Alignment exclusions and residuals, full query count and per-person support.

comparators.name: Matched language-only
comparators.inputs: Training corpus/calibration and exactly the declared fixed LM identity; no query neural signal or transcript.
comparators.procedure: Required complete prediction artifact. Comparator fitting/competence is not proved by its lm_id metadata.

comparators.name: Pinned V1 neural decoder
comparators.inputs: Same allowed V1 neural observations and calibration budget.
comparators.procedure: Prospective source-derived reference; not executed by the evaluator package.

nuisance_controls: Resolve MEG subject aliases before all splits.
Freeze template-family grouping and DTW exclusions before evaluation.
Retain ocular/motor contamination as an unresolved alternative; language-only comparison alone cannot isolate cerebral linguistic information.
evaluation.uncertainty: Implemented paired person cluster percentile bootstrap with frozen seed/replicates; one person is descriptive only. Cross-modal identity, template dependence and authentic inclusion require external audit.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject duplicate/extra/missing IDs, malformed alphabet, unknown target definitions, unexplained alignment loss and split leaks; no partial score. Empty predictions are valid complete deletion controls.

resources.basis: Planning estimate only; reuse author processed inputs first. Training/runtime/storage not measured for this task.

holds.requirement: Resolve same-person aliases and DTW trigger alignment; V1 only; audit decoder/checkpoint compatibility.
Version2embargoed data excluded; this row is V1only.
Exact full LM training corpus unavailable: no whole-paper final-number promise; neural-only scope.
Subject alias mapping and trigger-alignment loss are mandatory gates before train/eval creation.
Validate full selected payloads, biological IDs, alignment, target privacy, finite values and exact public/private packet hashes.
Freeze source versions, selection/exclusion, fitting and case-adaptive access, resource budget, split and primary estimator before outcomes.
Execute a signal-derived reference and independently checked comparator under this exact contract; record resources and matched controls.
Implement evaluator and negative tests for IDs, malformed/constant outputs, leakage, missingness and relevant null controls.
Independently reproduce scoring and reference; determine scientific admission criteria before agent outcomes. Public data remain development.
